body: Government/ Sustainable Finance Mark Segal September 29, 2026 Italy’s Ministry of Economy and Finance announced the completion of a new green bond offering, raising €8 billion to finance projects with a positive environmental impacts, in areas including renewable energy, energy efficiency and clean transport. The ministry reported strong demand for the new 12-year green bond, with the offering more than 13x oversubscribed, and an order book exceeding €110 billion. The offering received orders from more than 330 investors across 35 countries, with approximately 75% from foreign investors. ESG investors accounted for approximately 80% of the placement, the ministry added. The offering follows the release in late 2025 of Italy’s new Green Bond Framework, which included updated criteria for identifying and reporting environmentally sustainable expenditures, and aimed to criteria for identifying and reporting environmentally sustainable expenditures. The green bond framework outlines 6 categories for eligible use of proceeds, including Renewable energy, Energy efficiency, Clean transport, Measures for climate and environmental resilience, Protection of the environment, water and biological diversity, and Environmental research. The ministry said that funds from the new offering will be allocated across all six categories, while the main components will target energy efficiency interventions for buildings and the transport category. Lead managers on the issuance included, Barclays, BNP Paribas, Deutsche Bank, Intesa Sanpaolo, JP Morgan and Société Générale.

body: Mark Segal September 29, 2026 The Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) announced plans to expand its sector standards with the development of a new standard designed to enable food and beverage companies to report on relevant impacts in their industries and value chains. The new planned food and beverage reporting standard will be the first to pilot GRI’s new streamlined approach to Sector Standards development, designed to significantly reduce the time needed for development. GRI Sustainability Reporting Standards are one of the most commonly accepted global standards for sustainability reporting by companies, developed to enable consistent reporting across companies and industries, providing clearer communication regarding sustainability matters to a broad range of stakeholders, including investors. The GRI’s standards are developed by the Global Sustainability Standards Board (GSSB). GRI sector standards aim to help identify sectors’ most significant impacts, and to reflect stakeholder expectations for sustainability reporting. The GRI published its first sector standard in 2021 covering the oil and gas sector, followed by standards for sectors including coal, agriculture, aquaculture and fishing, mining, and textiles and apparel. Sectors selected for standard development are prioritized based on the seriousness and the likelihood of their impacts, with consideration also given to the overall size of the sector, their distribution around the world, and the number of organizations that are in a position to use the GRI Standards. On its project page, GRI noted that food and beverage industries are responsible for around one third of global emissions, have a direct impact on people’s health, and present safety risks for their workers. The new standard will cover food processing, manufacturing of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, and tobacco products, and will consider impacts across companies’ own operations and value chains, including connections with agriculture, aquaculture, and fishing. GRI’s new streamlined sector standard development approach is designed to enable faster delivery of industry-specific impact reporting guidance.
bodyZh: 马克·西格尔 (Mark Segal) 2026 年 9 月 29 日 全球报告倡议组织 (GRI) 宣布计划扩大其行业标准，制定一项新标准，旨在使食品和饮料公司能够报告其行业和价值链的相关影响。新计划的食品和饮料报告标准将是第一个试点 GRI 新的简化行业标准制定方法的标准，旨在显着减少制定所需的时间。 GRI 可持续发展报告标准是公司最普遍接受的可持续发展报告全球标准之一，旨在实现跨公司和行业的一致报告，为包括投资者在内的广泛利益相关者提供有关可持续发展问题的更清晰的沟通。 GRI 的标准由全球可持续发展标准委员会 (GSSB) 制定。 GRI 行业标准旨在帮助确定行业最重大的影响，并反映利益相关者对可持续发展报告的期望。 GRI 于 2021 年发布了涵盖石油和天然气行业的首个行业标准，随后又发布了煤炭、农业、水产养殖和渔业、采矿以及纺织服装等行业的标准。选择用于标准制定的行业是根据其影响的严重性和可能性来确定优先顺序的，同时还考虑该行业的总体规模、其在世界各地的分布以及有能力使用 GRI 标准的组织数量。 GRI 在其项目页面上指出，食品和饮料行业排放量约占全球排放量的三分之一，对人们的健康有直接影响，并给工人带来安全风险。新标准将涵盖食品加工、酒精和非酒精饮料的制造以及烟草产品，并将考虑对公司自身运营和价值链的影响，包括与农业、水产养殖和渔业的联系。 GRI 全新简化的行业标准制定方法旨在更快地交付针对特定行业的影响报告指南。

body: Kenny Fisher September 29, 2026 Netherlands-based insurance group Achmea’s investment unit, Achmea Investment Management, and asset manager ILX Management announced a partnership aimed at providing an emerging markets debt impact vehicle for Dutch pension funds. According to the companies, the new platform is being proposed to meet the growing ambition of institutional investors to generate both financial returns and positive societal impact through their investments. Manfred Schepers, CEO of ILX, said: “By connecting public and private capital more effectively, we contribute to sustainable development in emerging markets while creating attractive investment opportunities for long-term investors.” The new proposed platform will provide institutional investors with access to private credit and loans originated by multilateral development banks (MDBs) and development finance institutions (DFIs), supporting the financing of companies and projects aimed at advancing sustainable economic development in emerging markets and developing economies (EMDEs). The majority of the portfolio will consist of loans with an explicit impact objective and a measurable contribution to social development, the companies said. Under the agreement, Achmea will contribute its experience in supporting clients address issues including climate change, biodiversity restoration, health, and equal opportunities, while ILX will provide its expertise in private debt investments in EMDEs and its relationships with development finance institutions. Maureen Schlejen, Chair of the Executive Board of Achmea IM, said: “With ILX, we have found a partner with unique expertise, experience, networks, and access to investment opportunities in emerging markets.

body: Energy Transition/ Private Equity & Venture Capital Kenny Fisher September 29, 2026 Fuel cell technology startup Reverion announced today that it has raised $175 in a Series B funding round, with proceeds aimed at significantly scaling up production of its power plants, capable of generating carbon negative energy to power industrial sites and data centers. Founded in 2022 as a spin-off from the Technical University of Munich, Germany-based Reverion develops power plants based on solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) technology that can generate electricity from biogas, natural gas or hydrogen. The systems also capture CO2 in the fuel stream for re-use or permanent storage. According to Reverion,when operated using biogas and combined with permanent storage of the captured biogenic CO2, the process can generate negative emissions. The company said that its solution is also reversible, enabling its plants to switch from electricity generation to electrolysis and use surplus electricity to produce hydrogen or methane for storage, enabling the system to generate power when renewable electricity supply is insufficient and to convert excess power into storable gases when there is excess renewable electricity on the grid. According to Reverion, its solid oxide fuel cell power plant technology converts biogas, natural gas, or hydrogen into electricity on demand at a world-record electrical efficiency of 74.2% – nearly double that of conventional generators. The company said that the new the majority of the new capital will be used for investment into a new megafactory in Germany, scaling its manufacturing capacity tenfold to 250 MW. Reverion noted that seven of its power plants are already in regular operation at customer sites, and that it is seeing demand outside of Germany, with its first international projects scheduled for delivery this year. Stephan Herrmann, CEO and co-founder of Reverion, said: “Solar and wind give us clean energy, but only when the weather cooperates. What the world needs is clean power on tap. By closing this Series B, we are laying the foundation for industrial mass production.

body: Mark Segal September 29, 2026 The International Organization for Standardization’s (ISO) long-awaited proposed net zero standard, ISO 14040, failed to pass a vote by member organizations required to advance to become a final standard in its current form, ESG Today has confirmed, after receiving record feedback throughout its 12-week consultation period. ISO said that the new proposed standard, designed to support companies in developing credible and comprehensive net zero transition plans, received nearly 5,000 comments. While the organization does not disclose the votes of individual member bodies or the reasons behind their positions, media reports citing sources familiar with the process, indicated that the opposition to the draft came from fossil fuel-producing countries. In an email communication to ESG Today, an ISO spokesperson confirmed that “ISO/DIS 14060 did not receive the level of approval required to advance in its current form.” The draft standard, released following a 2-year development process, was designed to provide globally consistent guidance for companies and other organizations navigating the transition to net zero, including setting out requirements for demonstrating that their strategy, targets and actions are compatible with reaching net zero, and that they are making credible and verifiable progress towards contributing to global net zero, in line with the Paris Agreement. Key requirements for alignment with the proposed standard included setting interim and long-term emissions reduction targets, and the publication of a transition plan within two years of setting a target, covering aspects including timelines, integration of strategy into the business model, and measurement and reporting on progress, as well as requirements for validation and verification. ISO released its draft net zero standard in June 2026. Following the typical process for a new proposed standard, ISO initiated a 12-week public consultation period through its national members in more than 170 countries.

fact.object: 为了取得真正的 ESG 进展，我们必须改革与可持续发展挂钩的高管薪酬

body: Mark Segal September 29, 2026 Sustainability-linked executive pay became a phenomenon in the early 2020s. Fortune 500 companies made public commitments to their green goals, and whether they met them directly affected CEOs’ year-end bonuses. I thought this might make meaningful progress towards tackling climate risk, but for all the good intentions behind these pay schemes, they failed. Spectacularly so, in fact. ESG targets are regularly hit at a rate of 128%, but we’re still on course to break the seventh of the nine planetary boundaries. So, if we’re overachieving against these targets but our planetary impact is becoming more and more negative, the question has to be asked: where did it all go wrong? It all begins with the targets themselves. In a bid to make them applicable to businesses across industries, they’ve been watered down into a generic checklist, which means a professional services firm and an oil company are often working to the same guidelines despite their environmental impact being vastly different. This generality makes these targets far too easy to hit – it could even be argued that they were designed to be achieved without much effort. One prime example is training completion; if employees sit through a set number of PowerPoints, a business can chalk that target off as a success. If it takes one afternoon to hit an annual ESG target, it’s no wonder we’re careering towards climate disaster. Another reason why ESG-linked executive pay is failing is that the executives it was meant to incentivise haven’t spent much time thinking about hitting these targets. I’m not saying CEOs don’t care about the environment, but when the pay-out for hitting the goals is just 5% of the total bonus pool – and that’s on the high end – it’s not enough to influence decision-making on a scale that delivers tangible change. All of the above is a fatal mixture for sustainability-linked pay in its current state, but there is a solution. We need a new metric, one I’m naming Return on Planet (ROP). The reason I’ve decided to call this new measurable ROP is that it’s built on the same architecture as financial metrics such as Return on Investment (ROI).
bodyZh: Mark Segal 2026 年 9 月 29 日 与可持续发展相关的高管薪酬在 2020 年代初成为一种现象。世界500强企业公开承诺绿色目标，能否实现直接影响CEO的年终奖金。我认为这可能会在应对气候风险方面取得有意义的进展，但尽管这些薪酬计划背后有良好的意图，但他们失败了。事实上，情况确实如此。 ESG 目标的实现率通常达到 128%，但我们仍有望突破九个地球边界中的第七个。因此，如果我们超额完成了这些目标，但我们对地球的影响却变得越来越负面，那么我们必须要问：到底哪里出了问题？这一切都始于目标本身。为了使它们适用于跨行业的企业，它们被淡化为通用清单，这意味着专业服务公司和石油公司经常遵循相同的指导方针，尽管它们对环境的影响截然不同。这种普遍性使得这些目标太容易实现——甚至可以说，这些目标的设计初衷是不需要太多努力就可以实现。一个典型的例子是培训完成；如果员工听完一定数量的 PowerPoint，企业就可以将这一目标视为成功。如果需要一个下午的时间才能实现年度 ESG 目标，那么我们正在走向气候灾难也就不足为奇了。与 ESG 相关的高管薪酬未能实现的另一个原因是，其本应激励的高管没有花太多时间考虑实现这些目标。我并不是说首席执行官们不关心环境，但当实现目标的支出仅占总奖金池的 5% 时（而且这是一个高端），它不足以影响决策以带来切实的改变。在目前的情况下，上述所有因素对于与可持续发展相关的薪酬来说都是致命的组合，但有一个解决方案。我们需要一个新的指标，我将其命名为地球回报率（ROP）。我决定将这种新的可衡量 ROP 称为“ROP”，是因为它与投资回报率 (ROI) 等财务指标建立在相同的架构之上。

body: Washington D.C., Sept. 28, 2026 — The Securities and Exchange Commission today announced settled charges against New York-based investment adviser Zoe Financial Inc. for failing to fully and fairly disclose material facts concerning conflicts of interest to its clients and prospective clients. According to the SEC order, Zoe Financial operated a referral service which used an algorithm to match third-party investment advisers in its network with individuals seeking a recommendation for an investment adviser. Zoe Financial salespeople typically would then follow up with individuals who did not schedule a meeting with one of the matches generated by the algorithm, and in ensuing conversations, salespeople often recommended additional advisers to the client, beyond the recommendations generated by the algorithm. In January 2023, Zoe Financial launched Zoe Wealth, through which Zoe Financial offered sub-advisory services, account onboarding assistance, and other back-office support for its network of investment advisers. The order finds that Zoe Financial had a financial incentive for advisers in its network to use Zoe Wealth and encouraged advisers to do so. Further, as described in the order, while Zoe Financial’s algorithm did not consider whether an adviser used Zoe Wealth when it generated recommendations, salespeople often became involved in the referral process, and on many occasions suggested advisers that had not been initially recommended by the algorithm. The order finds that Zoe Financial did not adequately disclose the resulting conflict of interest in its Form ADV Brochure until December 2024. In addition, according to the order, while Zoe Financial disclosed that certain advisory firms held indirect minority interests in Zoe Financial and that this presented a conflict, Zoe Financial did not accurately describe how it mitigated that conflict. “Investment advisers have a fiduciary obligation to fully and fairly disclose material conflicts of interest,” said Sheldon Pollock, Associate Director of the SEC’s New York Regional Office.
bodyZh: 华盛顿特区，2026 年 9 月 28 日 — 美国证券交易委员会今天宣布对总部位于纽约的投资顾问 Zoe Financial Inc. 提出和解指控，指控其未能全面、公平地向其客户和潜在客户披露有关利益冲突的重要事实。根据 SEC 的命令，Zoe Financial 运营一项推荐服务，该服务使用算法将其网络中的第三方投资顾问与寻求投资顾问推荐的个人进行匹配。 Zoe Financial 销售人员通常会跟进那些没有安排与算法生成的匹配项之一会面的个人，在随后的对话中，销售人员通常会向客户推荐除算法生成的建议之外的其他顾问。 2023 年 1 月，Zoe Financial 推出了 Zoe Wealth，Zoe Financial 通过该服务为其投资顾问网络提供次级咨询服务、账户开户协助和其他后台支持。该命令发现，Zoe Financial 为其网络中的顾问使用 Zoe Wealth 提供经济激励，并鼓励顾问这样做。此外，正如命令中所述，虽然 Zoe Financial 的算法在生成推荐时没有考虑顾问是否使用 Zoe Wealth，但销售人员经常参与推荐过程，并且在很多情况下建议的顾问最初并未被算法推荐。该命令发现，Zoe Financial 直到 2024 年 12 月才在其 ADV 表格手册中充分披露由此产生的利益冲突。此外，根据该命令，虽然 Zoe Financial 披露某些咨询公司间接持有 Zoe Financial 少数股权，这构成了冲突，但 Zoe Financial 并未准确描述其如何缓解这种冲突。美国证券交易委员会纽约地区办事处副主任谢尔登·波洛克表示：“投资顾问负有充分、公平地披露重大利益冲突的信托义务。”

body: Mark Segal September 28, 2026 New York City Comptroller Mark Levine announced that he is recommending a strategic expansion in private markets climate solutions investments for three of the City’s public pension funds, with plans to present $5 billion in new private market investment opportunities. New York City’s pension funds represent nearly $300 billion in assets – making them collectively one of the largest public pension systems in the U.S. – and include the New York City Employees’ Retirement System (NYCERS), Teachers’ Retirement System (TRS), and Board of Education Retirement System (BERS). The Comptroller is the investment advisor to and custodian of assets of the city’s pension funds. In 2022, the NYC pension boards launched a Net Zero Implementation Plan, including a target to achieve net zero emissions by 2040, and implementing climate solutions investing as a pillar, with a goal of investing $37.8 billion by 2035. The Comptroller’s office noted that progress on climate solutions investments to date has mostly come from the appreciation of technology stocks in the passive portfolios, and presented private market proactive climate investing strategy as a step toward meeting the pension system’s goal. The new private market opportunities will be focused on areas including renewable power generation, grid modernization, energy efficiency and storage, clean transportation, and building decarbonization, as well as technologies that can reduce pollution, strengthen energy and water security, and improve resilience to extreme weather. Investment opportunities will be presented to each pension board for consideration and approval, subject to each of the three Systems’ independent due-diligence and fiduciary review processes. According to the Comptroller’s office, the new initiative comes as rising energy prices, geopolitical uncertainty, and growing energy demand are putting renewed pressure on energy costs, driving demand for more reliable and resilient energy infrastructure, and presenting attractive investment opportunities for the city’s pension systems.
bodyZh: 马克·西格尔 (Mark Segal) 2026 年 9 月 28 日纽约市审计长马克·莱文 (Mark Levine) 宣布，他建议对纽约市的三个公共养老基金进行私募市场气候解决方案投资的战略扩张，并计划提供 50 亿美元的新私募市场投资机会。纽约市的养老基金代表着近 3000 亿美元的资产，使其成为美国最大的公共养老金系统之一，其中包括纽约市雇员退休系统 (NYCERS)、教师退休系统 (TRS) 和教育委员会退休系统 (BERS)。主计长是该市养老基金的投资顾问和资产托管人。 2022年，纽约市养老金委员会推出了净零实施计划，其中包括到2040年实现净零排放的目标，并以实施气候解决方案投资为支柱，目标是到2035年投资378亿美元。主计长办公室指出，迄今为止，气候解决方案投资的进展主要来自被动投资组合中科技股的升值，并提出了私募市场主动气候投资策略，作为实现养老金制度目标的一步。新的私人市场机会将集中在可再生能源发电、电网现代化、能源效率和存储、清洁交通和建筑脱碳等领域，以及减少污染、加强能源和水安全以及提高抵御极端天气能力的技术。投资机会将提交给每个养老金委员会审议和批准，但须遵守三个系统的独立尽职调查和信托审查流程。据审计长办公室称，这项新举措出台之际，能源价格上涨、地缘政治不确定性和不断增长的能源需求给能源成本带来了新的压力，推动了对更可靠和更有弹性的能源基础设施的需求，并为该市的养老金系统提供了有吸引力的投资机会。

body: Government/ Investors/ Sustainable Finance Mark Segal September 28, 2026 J.P. Morgan Asset Management’s (JPMAM) natural capital unit, J.P. Morgan Natural Capital, and the Office of the President of the Republic of Paraguay announced the launch of a new large-scale sustainable forestry platform, with an investment of approximately $200 million. According to JPMorgan, the new platform investment focuses on establishing commercial forests, advancing native forest restoration, and creating long-term value through the sustainable production of high-quality timber, carbon credits, and wood-products. Capital deployment is expected to begin in early 2027. The partners added that the new initiative is expected to support broader regionalized development, create quality employment in rural areas, and strengthen local communities by combining international capital, Paraguayan capabilities, and the sustainable use of natural resources, with a long-term vision to advance Paraguay’s industrialization by processing timber locally, adding value at the source, and producing finished products for domestic and export markets. Santiago Peña, President of the Republic of Paraguay, said: “This announcement reflects Paraguay’s commitment to creating quality opportunities outside our major cities—building stronger rural communities while stewarding our natural resources responsibly. We welcome long-term partners who invest with a focus on sustainable development, job creation, and adding value in Paraguay.” The new initiative is being developed in partnership with Paraguayan business group Grupo Robinson, which the partners said will contribute local knowledge, production expertise, and a long-term vision for the sustainable development of the sector. The launch of the new platform follows JPMAM’s recent rebranding of its timberland investment advisory company Campbell Global to J.P. Morgan Natural Capital, in a move described by the company as aimed at reflecting the evolution of the business and the growing importance of nature-based assets in institutional portfolios. body: Environment/ Investors/ Sustainable Finance Mark Segal September 28, 2026 Paris-based international banking and investment group Crédit Agricole announced Monday the launch of Crédit Agricole Capital Naturel, a new division focused on supporting companies, investors and other stakeholders in addressing challenges related to the preservation and restoration of natural resources, with an initial focus on forests. The announcement marks the latest move by major financial players to deepen their focus on the natural capital sector, following JP Morgan’s recently announced rebrand of its timberland investment advisory company Campbell Global to J.P. Morgan Natural Capital, establishing an $11 billion platform positioned to capitalize on broader investment opportunities across land, carbon, biodiversity, and other nature-related investments. According to Crédit Agricole, the new division will bring together expertise from across the firm’s business lines and retail banks to help support clients across Europe across the regeneration value chain by offering them advisory, financing, insurance, investment, project structuring and natural asset enhancement solutions. The bank said that the new division will support companies looking to finance projects, reduce environmental footprint and secure sustainable supplies, investors looking for new asset classes with a sustainable investment objective, owners of natural assets who want to improve the resilience and value of their assets, local authorities committed to preserving their attractiveness, the resilience of their regions and the regeneration of their ecosystems, as well as savers looking to invest in natural capital asset classes and regional banks looking to provide region-specific solutions. As part of the development of the new business line, Crédit Agricole also revealed that it has entered into exclusive negotiations with nature-based solutions developer and operator EcoTree, with a view to acquiring a majority stake in the company.

body: Mark Segal September 28, 2026 UK-based banking group Barclays has appointed Paul Williams as its new Global Head of Operational Sustainability. In his new role, Williams will be responsible for leading Barclays’ sustainable operations strategy, embedding sustainability across Procurement, Global Real Estate, Technology and wider business operations to help deliver on the bank’s strategic commitments, regulatory requirements and long-term sustainability objectives. Williams joins Barclays from Deutsche Bank, where he has served since 2024 as Global Head of Sustainable Procurement. Prior to joining Deutsche Bank, he served as Global Head of Environmental & Social Sustainability at international food and beverage group Princes Limited, and he also founded and chairs the Finance Initiative for Sustainable Procurement (FISP), a collaboration of financial services institutions accelerating sustainability performance across shared supply networks.

body: Mark Segal September 28, 2026 The International Organization for Standardization (ISO) and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) announced today the launch of ISO/UNDP 53001, Management systems for the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) – Requirements, a new standard aimed at enabling organizations to integrate the UN SDGs into strategy, governance and operations. The UN SDGs refer to the 17 categories of goals adopted in 2015 as part of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, with the aim to protect the planet and improve the quality of life globally. SDG targets include ending poverty and hunger, improving education, and protecting the environment. ISO Secretary-General Sergio Mujica said: “The SDGs have provided a shared global vision for a decade. Today, organizations are looking for concrete ways to translate that vision into action. International Standards have long helped organizations address complex global challenges by providing a common language and a shared framework for action. We are delighted to launch ISO/UNDP 53001 today, extending this proven approach to the SDGs and helping organizations create positive impact for people and planet.” According to ISO and the UNDP, the new standard provides tools to enable organizations to identify and assess their beneficial and adverse impacts, engage relevant interested parties, establish meaningful SDG objectives, collect data and evaluate progress. The new standard specifies requirements for a management system to optimize an organization’s contribution to achieving the SDGs. The standard specifies requirements for analyzing organizational context and engaging with relevant parties to identify, assessing and prioritizing actual and potential impacts, setting organizational SDG objectives and targets, collecting data on impacts, making decisions taking into account the risks that those experiencing the organizations impacts can accept, and understanding and managing interdependencies, synergies and trade-offs to achieve positive results, avoid unintended adverse impacts, and help to achieve the SDGs.
bodyZh: 马克·西格尔 (Mark Segal) 2026 年 9 月 28 日 国际标准化组织 (ISO) 和联合国开发计划署 (UNDP) 今天宣布推出 ISO/UNDP 53001《联合国可持续发展目标 (SDG) 管理体系 – 要求》，这是一项新标准，旨在帮助组织将联合国可持续发展目标纳入战略、治理和运营。联合国可持续发展目标是指2015年通过的17类目标，作为2030年可持续发展议程的一部分，旨在保护地球并提高全球生活质量。可持续发展目标包括消除贫困和饥饿、改善教育和保护环境。 ISO秘书长塞尔吉奥·穆希卡表示：“十年来，可持续发展目标提供了共同的全球愿景。如今，各组织正在寻找将这一愿景转化为行动的具体方法。长期以来，国际标准通过提供共同语言和共享行动框架，帮助各组织应对复杂的全球挑战。我们很高兴今天推出ISO/UNDP 53001，将这一行之有效的方法扩展到可持续发展目标，并帮助各组织为人类和地球创造积极影响。” ISO 和 UNDP 表示，新标准提供了工具，使组织能够识别和评估其有利和不利影响，吸引相关利益方参与，建立有意义的可持续发展目标，收集数据并评估进展情况。新标准规定了管理体系的要求，以优化组织对实现可持续发展目标的贡献。该标准规定了分析组织背景并与相关方合作识别、评估和优先考虑实际和潜在影响的要求，设定组织可持续发展目标的目标和具体目标，收集影响数据，在制定决策时考虑那些遭受组织影响的人可以接受的风险，理解和管理相互依赖性、协同作用和权衡，以取得积极成果，避免意外的不利影响，并帮助实现可持续发展目标。

body: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX) today (Monday) launched "A Place to Connect: Our 40 Years at Exchange Square", a photo-led exhibition celebrating the development of Hong Kong's capital markets over the four decades since the establishment of Hong Kong’s modern stock exchange. HKEX hosted a special event to kick off the four-week exhibition, attended by distinguished guests that included Hong Kong Acting Financial Secretary, Michael Wong, as well as legislators, market regulators and leaders from the financial community. Former HKEX chairmen Ronald Arculli and CK Chow, and executives from the exhibition’s strategic partner, Hongkong Land, were also in attendance. The programme featured a gong-strike ceremony and a fireside chat between HKEX Chairman, Carlson Tong, Legislative Council Member for Financial Services, Robert Lee, and veteran financial journalist, Gina San, who reflected on the transformation of Hong Kong’s capital markets in the years following the launch of the unified Stock Exchange of Hong Kong (SEHK) at Exchange Square in 1986. HKEX Chairman, Carlson Tong, said: "For four decades, Exchange Square has stood at the heart of Hong Kong's capital markets, witnessing Hong Kong's rise as a leading international financial centre. Throughout this journey, the Exchange, its markets and our participants have supported Hong Kong’s economic development by connecting capital with opportunity and linking China with the world. Our commitment to establish HKEX's permanent headquarters at Exchange Square reflects our long-term confidence in Hong Kong and our determination to support the continued success and competitiveness of its financial markets." HKEX Chief Executive Officer, Bonnie Y Chan, said: “Exchange Square is more than the home of HKEX. It is where markets, businesses, investors and communities come together. Through this exhibition, we are sharing the stories, people and moments that have shaped Hong Kong’s capital markets over the past 40 years, while looking ahead to new ways of engaging with the public through our future headquarters, enhanced HKEX Connect Hall and new HKEX museum.
bodyZh: 香港交易及结算所有限公司（香港交易所）今日（星期一）推出“互联互通：交易广场四十年”摄影展览，庆祝香港现代证券交易所成立四十年来香港资本市场的发展。香港交易所举办了一场特别活动，为为期四周的展览拉开帷幕，出席嘉宾包括香港署理财政司司长黄伟纶，以及立法会议员、市场监管机构和金融界领袖。香港交易所前主席夏佳理和周长强，以及展览战略合作伙伴置地公司的高管也出席了活动。节目包括敲锣仪式以及香港交易所主席唐嘉信、金融业立法会议员李智铨和资深财经记者桑洁娜之间的炉边谈话，他们回顾了自 1986 年在交易广场成立统一的香港联合交易所（联交所）以来香港资本市场的转变。香港交易所主席唐嘉信表示：“四十年来，交易广场一直是香港资本市场的核心，在见证香港崛起为领先国际金融中心的过程中，联交所、其市场和我们的参与者通过连接资本与机会以及连接中国与世界来支持香港的经济发展。我们致力于在交易广场设立香港交易所的永久总部，反映了我们对香港的长期信心以及支持香港金融市场持续成功和竞争力的决心。”香港交易所行政总裁陈美龄表示：“交易广场不仅仅是香港交易所的家，也是市场、企业、投资者和社区汇聚的地方。通过这次展览，我们将分享过去40年来塑造香港资本市场的故事、人物和时刻，同时展望通过我们未来的总部、升级后的香港交易所通大厅和新的香港交易所博物馆，以新的方式与公众互动。”

body: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX) today (Monday) welcomed the launch of four exchange traded funds (ETFs) tracking three of its cross-market indices this month, marking an important milestone in the continued expansion of the Group's index business and reinforcing its commitment to developing innovative products that support diversified investment opportunities for regional and international investors. The newly-listed ETFs track the HKEX Bursa Malaysia Large Cap Index, the HKEX KRX Semiconductor Index, and the HKEX Tech & US Tech 100 Index. These are the first investment products based on the three benchmarks, launched earlier this year to strengthen connectivity between Hong Kong and key regional and international markets, with the first two indices introduced as part of co-branded partnerships with Bursa Malaysia Berhad (Bursa Malaysia) and Korea Exchange (KRX), respectively. HKEX Chief Executive Officer, Bonnie Y Chan, said: "We are delighted to welcome the first ETFs tracking HKEX’s cross-market index series. Their launch marks an important step in our efforts to connect Hong Kong with international markets by working with exchanges and partners across Asia and beyond to broaden investor choice. By bringing together opportunities across different markets and sectors, these benchmarks respond to investors' growing demand for diversification and reinforce Hong Kong's role as a gateway connecting the Chinese Mainland with the rest of the world." Bursa Malaysia Chief Executive Officer, Dato’ Fad’l Mohamed, said: “We welcome the launch of Da Cheng International’s ETF tracking the HKEX Bursa Malaysia Large Cap Index, marking the first investment product based on the co-branded benchmark. Bringing together 30 leading listed companies each from Malaysia and Hong Kong, the index provides investors with a new pathway to access opportunities across both markets.

title: The impact of financing cost differences on global energy and industry decarbonization
summary: Abstract Integrated assessment models usually neglect differences in financing conditions across countries, sectors and time. This omission could distort outcomes concerning electricity generation and also other sectors. Here we estimate and implement dynamic, country-specific cost of capital (CoC) for eight energy and industry sectors in the IMAGE integrated assessment model. Compared with assuming a uniform low-risk CoC, accounting for developing countries’ investment risks increases global mitigation costs through 2100 for staying well below +2 °C by around 9% and shifts cost-effective mitigation efforts to lower-risk regions. Sector-level analysis shows that using granular CoC estimates reduces grid investments in developing countries, shifts centralized heat production towards natural gas and raises green hydrogen costs, slowing electrolysis uptake. In industries such as steel and cement, sector and country risks hinder capital-intensive carbon capture and electricity-based technologies. Our results reveal biases from omitting country-specific financing conditions and highlight the need for climate finance across many sectors.

whyMatters: 学术精选：高相关：直接研究 ESG/非财务绩效或披露；期刊强：高影响力期刊。建议结合所在行业与议题评估实践价值。
titleZh: 融资成本差异对全球能源和行业脱碳的影响
summaryZh: 摘要 综合评估模型通常忽略了不同国家、不同行业、不同时间融资条件的差异。这种遗漏可能会扭曲发电和其他部门的结果。在这里，我们在 IMAGE 综合评估模型中估算并实施了八个能源和工业部门的动态、特定国家的资本成本 (CoC)。与假设统一的低风险CoC相比，考虑到发展中国家的投资风险，到2100年，全球保持远低于+2°C的缓解成本将增加约9%，并将具有成本效益的缓解努力转移到风险较低的地区。行业层面的分析表明，使用精细的 CoC 估算可以减少发展中国家的电网投资，将集中供热生产转向天然气，并提高绿色氢成本，从而减缓电解的采用。在钢铁和水泥等行业，部门和国家风险阻碍了资本密集型碳捕获和电力技术。我们的结果揭示了由于忽略特定国家融资条件而产生的偏差，并强调了许多部门对气候融资的需求。

body: Washington D.C., Sept. 23, 2026 — The Securities and Exchange Commission’s Division of Economic and Risk Analysis (DERA) published updated statistics and data visualizations covering key segments of the U.S. capital markets, including a notable increase in the number of initial public offerings (IPOs) and follow-on registered offerings. Key Highlights: First Half 2026 In the first half of 2026, IPO and follow-on offering activity showed year-over-year growth: These and other statistics can be found on the SEC’s public statistics and data visualizations webpage. The webpage provides statistics presented in time series charts to show market trends, pie charts to show distribution across different categories, as well as heat maps to show geographic distributions. The visuals are interactive and downloadable, thus allowing the public to explore the information they are interested in. “DERA’s latest data highlight the continued strengthening of U.S. capital formation under Chairman Atkins, with notable growth in both IPOs and follow‑on offerings,” said Dr. Joshua T. White, Chief Economist and Director of the SEC's Division of Economic and Risk Analysis. “By expanding access to transparent, high‑quality data and analysis, DERA aims to equip the public, market participants, and policymakers with insights that support resilient and well functioning capital markets.” DERA integrates financial economics and rigorous data analytics into the SEC’s core mission. It provides high-quality economic and statistical analyses to inform Commission rulemaking and oversight, and helps identify and respond to emerging issues, trends, and innovations in the marketplace. Last Reviewed or Updated: Sept.

fact.object: 美国证券交易委员会指控南佛罗里达州居民及其公司涉嫌投资计划欺诈执法部门

body: Washington D.C., Sept. 23, 2026 — The Securities and Exchange Commission today charged CMI Capital LLC and its founder and manager, Michael D. Williams, for an alleged fraudulent investment scheme that raised approximately $860,000 from at least 18 investors, many of whom are current or retired law enforcement officers in South Florida. The defendants have agreed to a bifurcated settlement in connection with the charges and subject to court approval. According to the SEC’s complaint, from at least October 2023 through August 2024, Williams, of Port St. Lucie, Florida, made numerous false and misleading statements in order to convince clients to invest in two funds that he controlled. The investors, many of whom trusted Williams because he worked for a third-party police and firefighter pension plan administrator, were allegedly told that one of the funds had a portfolio value of more than $5 million and achieved returns exceeding 140 percent. “We allege that one of the tactics the defendants used to trick investors was to send them cropped screenshots of graphics that showed exorbitant trading profits,” said Stephanie N. Moot, Director of the SEC’s Miami Regional Office. “We strongly urge all investors to use caution when entrusting their funds to others and to be wary of anyone promising high returns with little to no risk.” Williams allegedly misappropriated approximately $384,000 of investor and client funds to pay for personal expenses, including credit card balances, a sports car, and vacations. According to the complaint, Williams began repaying certain investors in August 2024 and has repaid more than $375,000 to certain investors. The SEC’s complaint, filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Florida, charges Williams and CMI Capital, which is also known to do business as Check Mate Investments, with violating antifraud and registration provisions of the Securities Act of 1933 and antifraud provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and Investment Advisers Act of 1940.

Williams 涉嫌实施欺诈性投资计划，该计划从至少 18 名投资者那里筹集了约 860,000 美元，其中许多人是南佛罗里达州的现任或退休执法人员。被告已同意就指控达成分叉和解，并须经法院批准。根据 SEC 的投诉，至少从 2023 年 10 月到 2024 年 8 月，来自佛罗里达州圣露西港的威廉姆斯发表了大量虚假和误导性陈述，以说服客户投资他控制的两只基金。投资者中的许多人信任威廉姆斯，因为他为第三方警察和消防员养老金计划管理员工作，据称他们被告知其中一只基金的投资组合价值超过 500 万美元，并实现了超过 140% 的回报。 “我们声称，被告用来欺骗投资者的策略之一就是向他们发送显示过高交易利润的图形截图，”美国证券交易委员会迈阿密地区办公室主任斯蒂芬妮·N·穆特（Stephanie N. Moot）说。 “我们强烈敦促所有投资者在将资金委托给他人时务必谨慎，并对任何承诺高回报、几乎没有风险的人保持警惕。”威廉姆斯据称挪用了约 384,000 美元的投资者和客户资金来支付个人开支，包括信用卡余额、跑车和度假。根据诉状，威廉姆斯于 2024 年 8 月开始偿还某些投资者，并已向某些投资者偿还了超过 375,000 美元。 SEC 向美国佛罗里达州南区地方法院提起诉讼，指控 Williams 和 CMI Capital（也称为 Check Mate Investments）违反 1933 年《证券法》的反欺诈和注册条款以及 1934 年《证券交易法》和 1940 年《投资顾问法》的反欺诈条款。

title: Sustainability reporting frameworks and environmental disclosure coverage in the Indian infrastructure industry: an empirical comparison of GRI and BRSR
summary: As the infrastructure industry affects the environment in many aspects, it ought to be evaluated and addressed through standardized reporting frameworks that create transparency and accountability for entities’ stakeholders. To comprehend the significance of these frameworks for communicating entities’ sustainable performance, it becomes necessary to examine various frameworks used and their level of acceptance in the infrastructure industry. Using prominent sustainability reporting frameworks such as the Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) and Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report (BRSR), this study examined the level of acceptance and alignment through in-depth content analysis, with specific reference to environmental disclosures. Additionally, the study used the Environmental Disclosure Index standard metric to assess the extent of environmental disclosures by companies in their non-financial reporting for the financial year (FY) 2024-2025, using a sample of five infrastructure industry companies. The findings demonstrate significant convergence between the BRSR and GRI frameworks in their environmental disclosure standards, yet each framework also contains indicators specific to its unique regulations and institutional context. Case companies exhibited similar and acceptable environmental disclosure quality (EDCI ranging from 0.49–0.71), while BRSR coverage varied notably, indicating the framework’s capacity to allow for voluntary indicator reporting. Notably, while BRSR addresses many environmental impacts crucial to the infrastructure industry, other aspects, such as noise pollution and construction-related disturbances, remain outside of its current disclosure scope. This study contributes to the BRSR-based sustainability disclosure literature by taking a sector-specific approach, providing policymakers and academics with insights for aligning national and international reporting requirements in emerging economic contexts.

titleZh: 印度基础设施行业的可持续发展报告框架和环境信息披露覆盖范围：GRI 和 BRSR 的实证比较
summaryZh: 由于基础设施行业在许多方面影响环境，因此应该通过标准化报告框架对其进行评估和解决，从而为实体的利益相关者创造透明度和问责制。为了理解这些框架对于沟通实体可持续绩效的重要性，有必要检查所使用的各种框架及其在基础设施行业中的接受程度。本研究利用全球报告倡议组织 (GRI) 和企业责任与可持续发展报告 (BRSR) 等著名的可持续发展报告框架，通过深入的内容分析（特别是环境披露）来检验接受程度和一致性。此外，该研究还使用环境披露指数标准指标来评估公司在 2024-2025 财年 (FY) 非财务报告中的环境披露程度，并以五家基础设施行业公司为样本。研究结果表明，BRSR 和 GRI 框架在环境披露标准方面存在显着趋同，但每个框架还包含针对其独特法规和制度背景的指标。案例公司表现出相似且可接受的环境披露质量（EDCI 范围为 0.49-0.71），而 BRSR 覆盖范围差异显着，表明该框架允许自愿指标报告的能力。值得注意的是，虽然 BRSR 解决了许多对基础设施行业至关重要的环境影响，但其他方面，例如噪音污染和与建筑相关的干扰，仍然超出了其当前的披露范围。

fact.subject: SEC 新闻稿（ESG 相关）
fact.object: SEC 谴责 OTC Link LLC 屡次未能遵守 SCI 法规

body: Washington D.C., Sept. 22, 2026 — The Securities and Exchange Commission today censured New York-based broker dealer OTC Link LLC and ordered it to pay a $575,000 civil penalty for longstanding violations of Regulation Systems Compliance and Integrity (SCI). According to the SEC’s settled order, between August 2016 and March 2025, OTC Link LLC failed to establish, maintain, and enforce certain written policies and procedures required by Regulation SCI for OTC Link ATS—an alternative trading system for over-the-counter securities that it operates—including policies and procedures pertaining to system security, access control, and application vulnerability management, testing, and remediation. Although staff in the SEC’s Division of Examinations examined OTC Link ATS several times during the relevant period and each time flagged certain required policies and procedures that the firm had not established or kept in draft form and failed to finalize or enforce, the SEC’s order finds that OTC Link LLC repeatedly failed to promptly remediate such deficiencies. “OTC Link’s continual failure to remediate deficiencies even after they were repeatedly flagged by Division of Examinations staff reflects a disregard for their findings and the overall examinations process and justifies a meaningful penalty,” said Laura D’Allaird, Chief of the Division of Enforcement’s Cyber and Emerging Technologies Unit. “All SCI entities are expected to take their regulatory responsibilities seriously and promptly fix issues when they're identified.” The SEC’s order finds that OTC Link LLC lacked written policies and procedures that were reasonably designed to ensure that OTC Link ATS’s SCI systems and, for purposes of security standards, indirect SCI systems, had levels of capacity, integrity, resiliency, availability, and security adequate to maintain OTC Link ATS’s operational capability and promote the maintenance of fair and orderly markets in violation of Rule 1001(a)(1) of Regulation SCI.
bodyZh: 华盛顿特区，2026 年 9 月 22 日 — 美国证券交易委员会今天谴责总部位于纽约的经纪交易商 OTC Link LLC，并命令其因长期违反监管系统合规性和完整性 (SCI) 行为而支付 575,000 美元的民事罚款。根据 SEC 的和解命令，2016 年 8 月至 2025 年 3 月期间，OTC Link LLC 未能针对 OTC Link ATS（其运营的场外证券替代交易系统）制定、维护和执行 SCI 法规要求的某些书面政策和程序，包括与系统安全、访问控制以及应用程序漏洞管理、测试和修复相关的政策和程序。尽管 SEC 考试部的工作人员在相关期间多次检查了 OTC Link ATS，并且每次都指出了该公司尚未制定或以草案形式保存且未能最终确定或执行的某些必要政策和程序，但 SEC 的命令发现 OTC Link LLC 一再未能及时纠正此类缺陷。执法部网络和新兴技术部门负责人 Laura D’Allaird 表示：“即使检查部工作人员多次指出，OTC Link 仍然未能纠正缺陷，这反映出对其调查结果和整体检查流程的漠视，并证明了有意义的处罚是合理的。” “所有SCI实体都应认真履行监管责任，并在发现问题时及时解决。” SEC 的命令发现，OTC Link LLC 缺乏合理设计的书面政策和程序，以确保 OTC Link ATS 的 SCI 系统以及出于安全标准目的的间接 SCI 系统具有足以维持 OTC Link ATS 运营能力并促进维护公平有序市场的容量、完整性、弹性、可用性和安全性水平，违反了 SCI 条例第 1001(a)(1) 条规则。

body: Over the past decade, China’s automotive industry has undergone a profound transformation, driven by both consumer behavior and industry evolution. Consumers are no longer passive observers. They have become active participants, shaping trends and making informed decisions about vehicle replacement cycles and price competition, while holding clear expectations about brands, electrification, and intelligent technologies. This report is a collaborative effort by Alexander Will, Daniel Birke, Mingyu Guan, and Thomas Fang, with Tony Zhou, representing views from McKinsey’s Automotive & Assembly Practice. In this increasingly complex auto market, understanding consumer sentiment is often more valuable than interpreting short-term data, offering actionable insights for industry stakeholders across the automotive ecosystem. Future industry leaders may be those who can turn innovation into consistent experiences, brands into trusted promises, and industry collaboration into systemic competitiveness. This report presents data from McKinsey’s tenth China Auto Consumer Insights survey, which tracks the behaviors and preferences of Chinese auto consumers. The survey was conducted in the first quarter of 2026 using online sampling, with 2,826 respondents completing the full survey. It covered 19 major cities across China, spanning tier-1 through tier-4 cities in the North, Northeast, East, Central and South, Southwest, and Northwest regions. Respondents were categorized by age, income, car-purchasing experience, and current vehicle brand and type. McKinsey has followed the evolution of the Chinese auto market for a decade, conducting annual surveys to gauge consumer sentiment and track market trends (see sidebar, “About the report”).
bodyZh: 过去十年，在消费者行为和行业演变的推动下，中国汽车行业经历了深刻的变革。消费者不再是被动的观察者。他们已成为积极的参与者，塑造趋势并就车辆更换周期和价格竞争做出明智的决策，同时对品牌、电气化和智能技术抱有明确的期望。本报告由 Alexander Will、Daniel Birke、Mingyuguan 和 Thomas Fang 以及 Tony Zhou 共同撰写，代表了麦肯锡汽车与装配业务部门的观点。在这个日益复杂的汽车市场中，了解消费者情绪通常比解释短期数据更有价值，为整个汽车生态系统的行业利益相关者提供可行的见解。未来的行业领导者可能是那些能够将创新转化为一致的体验、将品牌转化为值得信赖的承诺、将行业协作转化为系统竞争力的人。本报告提供了麦肯锡第十次中国汽车消费者洞察调查的数据，该调查跟踪了中国汽车消费者的行为和偏好。该调查于 2026 年第一季度采用在线抽样方式进行，共有 2,826 名受访者完成了完整调查。覆盖全国19个主要城市，覆盖华北、东北、华东、中南、西南、西北地区的一至四线城市。受访者按年龄、收入、购车经验以及当前车辆品牌和类型进行分类。麦肯锡十年来一直关注中国汽车市场的演变，每年进行调查以衡量消费者情绪并跟踪市场趋势（见附文“关于报告”）。

body: Washington D.C., Sept. 17, 2026 — The Securities and Exchange Commission today issued an order granting temporary, conditional exemptive relief to Tokenized Securities Venues each a “TSV” from the definition of “exchange” in the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (Exchange Act) to trade tokenized National Market System (NMS) stock using innovative permissioned automated market makers and liquidity pools (together “AMM Liquidity Pools”). “Today, the Securities and Exchange Commission is taking a significant step forward, within its statutory authority, to bring America’s capital markets into the digital age by facilitating onchain trading of certain tokenized stocks through the ‘Innovation Exemption,’” said SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins in a statement. “The Innovation Exemption, while temporary, would allow TSVs to trade tokenized NMS stock in a permissioned environment today while the Commission considers the need for additional action to facilitate onchain trading. As we take this important first step, we invite public comment on all aspects of the Innovation Exemption to help inform the Commission as it considers further changes.” “Today’s approval of exemptive relief for on-chain secondary trading on a TSV – known as the ‘Innovation Exemption’ – marks an important milestone for the Commission’s work to open our capital markets for tokenized securities,” said Jamie Selway, Director of the SEC Division of Trading and Markets. “The division stands ready to work with interested parties seeking to operate a TSV and field questions from investors and market participants.” TSVs bring together buyers and sellers of tokenized NMS stock by: (1) providing one or more AMM Liquidity Pool(s) for permissioned participants to interact and agree to terms of a trade and (2) setting standards for persons to access trading on such AMM Liquidity Pool(s).
bodyZh: 华盛顿特区，2026 年 9 月 17 日 — 美国证券交易委员会今天发布命令，根据 1934 年《证券交易法》（《交易法》）中“交易所”的定义，向代币化证券交易场所授予临时、有条件的豁免救济，以使用创新型许可的自动化做市商和流动性池（统称“AMM 流动性池”）交易代币化全国市场系统 (NMS) 股票。 “今天，美国证券交易委员会在其法定权力范围内迈出了重要一步，通过‘创新豁免’促进某些代币化股票的链上交易，将美国资本市场带入数字时代，”美国证券交易委员会主席保罗·S·阿特金斯在一份声明中表示。 “创新豁免虽然是暂时的，但将允许 TSV 在许可的环境中交易代币化的 NMS 股票，同时委员会认为需要采取额外行动来促进链上交易。在我们迈出这一重要的第一步时，我们邀请公众就创新豁免的各个方面发表意见，以帮助在委员会考虑进一步的变化时向其通报情况。” “今天批准对 TSV 链上二级交易的豁免（称为‘创新豁免’）标志着委员会为代币化证券开放资本市场的工作的一个重要里程碑，”SEC 交易和市场部主任 Jamie Selway 表示。 “该部门随时准备与寻求运营 TSV 的感兴趣方合作，并回答投资者和市场参与者提出的问题。” TSV 通过以下方式将代币化 NMS 股票的买家和卖家聚集在一起：(1) 提供一个或多个 AMM 流动性池，供获得许可的参与者进行互动并同意交易条款；(2) 为人们在此类 AMM 流动性池上进行交易制定标准。

body: Washington D.C., Sept. 16, 2026 — The Securities and Exchange Commission today proposed to rescind Rule 14a-8 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, which exceeds the scope of the Commission's statutory authority and intrudes into matters of state law. The Commission outlined independent policy reasons for its proposed rescission of Rule 14a-8. Many of the justifications for adopting the rule either have not been substantiated in practice or are less compelling today, and the rule has had unintended consequences, including the implication of federal preemption that may have discouraged states from developing their own laws governing shareholder proposals. Rescinding Rule 14a-8 would leave determinations about the role of shareholder proposals to state law and company governing documents. "Today, the Commission issued two proposing releases related to its proxy rules under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The proposals reflect two of my highest regulatory priorities. First, ensuring that the Commission does not improperly intrude into state corporate law when applying the federal securities laws. Second, updating the Commission’s rules to reflect developments in market practice and technology, and other innovations, since the rules’ adoption or last amendment," said SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins in a statement. "Today’s proposals demonstrate my focus on ensuring that the Commission’s rules are within the agency’s statutory authority and reflect policy positions grounded in current and anticipated market practice and modern technologies. I look forward to receiving and reviewing the public’s feedback on both proposals." The Commission also proposed amendments to Rule 14a-4(c) under the Exchange Act to provide companies with greater flexibility and shareholders with greater control regarding proposals for which a company may seek discretionary proxy voting authority. The Commission separately proposed rule amendments to modernize the proxy solicitation process.
bodyZh: 华盛顿特区，2026 年 9 月 16 日 — 美国证券交易委员会今天提议废除 1934 年《证券交易法》中的第 14a-8 条规则，该规则超出了委员会的法定权限并侵犯了州法律事务。委员会概述了提议废除第 14a-8 条的独立政策原因。采用该规则的许多理由要么在实践中没有得到证实，要么在今天缺乏说服力，并且该规则产生了意想不到的后果，包括联邦优先权的影响，这可能会阻碍各州制定自己的股东提案管理法律。废除规则 14a-8 将使有关股东提案的作用的决定留给州法律和公司治理文件。 “今天，委员会发布了两份与 1934 年《证券交易法》下的代理规则相关的提案。这些提案反映了我的两项最高监管优先事项。首先，确保委员会在适用联邦证券法时不会不当侵入州公司法。其次，更新委员会的规则，以反映自规则通过或上次修订以来市场实践和技术以及其他创新的发展，”SEC 主席保罗·S·阿特金斯 (Paul S. Atkins) 在一份声明中表示。 “今天的提案表明，我致力于确保委员会的规则符合该机构的法定权限，并反映基于当前和预期的市场实践以及现代技术的政策立场。我期待收到并审查公众对这两项提案的反馈。”委员会还提议修订《交易法》第 14a-4(c) 条，为公司提供更大的灵活性，并为股东提供对公司寻求全权代理投票权提案的更大控制权。委员会单独提出了规则修正案，以使委托书征集流程现代化。

body: Washington D.C., Sept. 14, 2026 — The Securities and Exchange Commission issued an order granting exemptive relief from certain Inline XBRL requirements adopted on Dec. 16, 2024. More specifically, the Commission is granting exemptive relief from filing or submitting the following in Inline XBRL: Form CA-1 (except Exhibit H thereto), Form 1 (except Exhibit I thereto), Form X-17A-5 Part III, Form 17‑H, and the annual compliance report of a security-based swap dealer or major security-based swap participant. These forms and submissions are specific to market intermediaries and are primarily used by the Commission to assess whether registered entities meet relevant standards – including legal, financial, and operational standards – necessary to comply with the Exchange Act. “This exemptive order – which provides commonsense relief without sacrificing investor protection – will reduce compliance costs and enable market participants to more efficiently allocate resources, including to support or enhance their operations and existing compliance obligations,” said SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins. “This action furthers the Commission’s efforts to transform our rulebook by trimming immaterial requirements that burden the market without materially benefitting investors.” The exemptive relief is expected to reduce potentially significant unnecessary compliance costs, which firms may ultimately pass on to investors through higher fees, without meaningful gains in transparency or data accessibility to investors. Last Reviewed or Updated: Sept.

title: Listening to the mountain: oral history, biocultural heritage, and sustainability transitions in Serra da Estrela
summary: This article draws on a corpus of oral history interviews collected in Serra da Estrela, Portugal, to examine how community memory, territorial knowledge, and lived relationships with the mountain contribute to understanding socio-ecological change and rethinking sustainability in a context of climate disruption. Focusing on territory already recognized as a UNESCO Global Geopark and currently proposed for inscription as a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, the study explores how oral testimony illuminates the biocultural dimensions of sustainability and the contribution of the Social Sciences and Humanities to sustainability transitions. The research adopts a qualitative, interpretive, and place-based design grounded in the Memory for All methodology and combines documentary analysis with oral history interviews addressing everyday life, pastoral activity, environmental perception, territorial change, and intergenerational transmission of knowledge. The results show that the interviews consistently converge around a set of major themes: the decline of pastoralism, demographic contraction, changing climatic conditions, wildfires, institutional inadequacy, and the reconfiguration of local economies. They also reveal Serra da Estrela as a lived socio-ecological system in which ecological processes, labor, memory, and identity remain deeply entangled. Particular attention is given to transhumance, analyzed through both historical literature and interview-based testimony as a practice that links mobility, adaptation, ecological knowledge, and cultural memory, while also acquiring renewed relevance in contemporary debates on biodiversity, fuel-load management, and regenerative territorial practices. The article argues that oral history enlarges the epistemic field of sustainability research by making audible forms of knowledge and experiences that remain only partially translated into technical and policy-oriented approaches. In doing so, it shows how methods grounded in the Social Sciences and Humanities can help reframe sustainability transitions as processes of cultural and epistemic transformation and contribute to more inclusive, territorially grounded, and socially meaningful pathways toward sustainable and circular societies. The findings also provide practical insights for policymakers, protected-area managers, and local stakeholders seeking to integrate community knowledge and biocultural heritage into sustainability transitions.

body: Every country tells itself a story about who it is. For most of the past hundred years, Australia’s story was simple and comfortable: It was the lucky country, where with a bit of effort, great results came naturally. “She’ll be right, mate,” as the uniquely Australian idiom puts it. Now, that story has changed, replaced by the very different sense that progress is stalling, that the country is no longer doing well, and that the birthright of prosperity is slipping away. Only 22 percent of Australians believe the next generation will be better off.12026 Edelman Trust Barometer: Trust amid insularity: Australia report, Edelman Trust Institute, 2026. Their lived experience suggests why: The country has not had such a slow decade of income growth since before the Second World War.2Jutta Bolt and Jan Luiten van Zanden, Maddison Project Database 2023 (adjusted for purchasing-power parity so that income levels can be compared across countries); Global Economic Model, Oxford Economics, 2025; GDP per capita (constant LCU), series NY.GDP.PCAP.KN, World Bank Group, July 2026 edition. Data from the World Bank uses each country’s own constant local currency. The Maddison Project and the World Bank show the same profile albeit different growth rates. But the story and the current perception share a flaw. Each casts Australia as a passive recipient of fortune: lucky then, unlucky now. Australia’s true experience is very different: It has made its own luck through deliberate choices, actions, and plain old “hard yakka.” That is the lesson offered in particular by Australia’s two boom periods (1945 to 1970 and 1993 to 2015)—periods we can learn from. The McKinsey Global Institute (MGI), in its book A Century of Plenty, offers a global perspective with additional lessons.3A Century of Plenty: A Story of Progress for Generations to Come, McKinsey Global Institute, 2026. MGI’s research demonstrates that the past century brought material advances in standards of living globally, and that a second century of plenty is within reach. The same is true for Australia.
bodyZh: 每个国家都在讲述自己的故事。在过去百年的大部分时间里，澳大利亚的故事简单而舒适：这是一个幸运的国家，只要付出一点努力，伟大的成果就会自然而然地到来。正如澳大利亚独特的习语所说，“她是对的，伙计”。现在，这个故事已经改变，取而代之的是一种截然不同的感觉：进步正在停滞，国家不再表现良好，繁荣的与生俱来的权利正在消失。只有 22% 的澳大利亚人相信下一代会过得更好。12026 爱德曼信托晴雨表：孤立中的信任：澳大利亚报告，爱德曼信托研究所，2026 年。他们的生活经验说明了原因：自第二次世界大战之前以来，该国的收入增长从未经历过如此缓慢的十年。2Jutta Bolt 和 Jan Luiten van Zanden，麦迪逊项目数据库 2023（根据购买力平价进行调整，以便可以比较收入水平）跨国家）；全球经济模型，牛津经济研究院，2025；人均 GDP（不变本币单位），NY.GDP.PCAP.KN 系列，世界银行集团，2026 年 7 月版。世界银行的数据使用每个国家自己的不变当地货币。尽管增长率不同，麦迪逊项目和世界银行却表现出相同的形象。但这个故事和当前的看法都有一个缺陷。每个人都将澳大利亚视为财富的被动接受者：过去幸运，现在不幸。澳大利亚的真实经历却截然不同：它通过深思熟虑的选择、行动和普通的“硬yakka”创造了自己的运气。这是澳大利亚的两个繁荣时期（1945年至1970年和1993年至2015年）特别提供的教训——我们可以从中学习。麦肯锡全球研究院 (MGI) 在其《丰盛的世纪》一书中提供了全球视角和额外的经验教训。3丰盛的世纪：子孙后代的进步故事，麦肯锡全球研究院，2026 年。麦肯锡全球研究院的研究表明，过去的一个世纪给全球生活水平带来了物质进步，第二个丰盛的世纪指日可待。澳大利亚也是如此。

body: Washington D.C., Sept. 11, 2026 — Senior officials from the Securities and Exchange Commission, Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, Commodity Futures Trading Commission, Federal Reserve Board, and Bank of England convened for a tabletop exercise on Sept. 3, 2026, to discuss certain issues relating to the hypothetical resolution of central counterparties (CCPs). This meeting was one of a regular series of senior-level meetings held since 2017 to share views on CCP resolution and review the progress of an ongoing program of joint work among the agencies. The meeting was an opportunity to review recent joint work undertaken by the agencies, in particular the information sharing and communications arrangements to support financial stability in the event of a CCP resolution. Participants acknowledged the importance of continuing to facilitate a dialogue between UK and U.S. authorities and continuing to share analyses and discussing policy formulation in relation to CCP resolution. body: Washington D.C., Sept. 10, 2026 — The Securities and Exchange Commission today charged Ernest Ossei Boateng and two New Jersey-based companies he controls, Intercontinental Wealth Network LLC and I Wealth Network LP, for allegedly raising approximately $16 million from more than 200 inexperienced investors through a Ponzi scheme he operated from at least January 2020 until at least March 2026. According to the SEC’s complaint, Boateng, acting through his two companies, solicited, recommended, and sold interests in an alleged investment fund, primarily targeting Christians of Ghanaian heritage in New York and New Jersey, many of whom had no prior investing experience. The complaint alleges that Boateng told investors that their investments would generate guaranteed fixed returns and that the investment fund would pursue a low-risk investment strategy. Rather than investing the money as promised, however, Boateng allegedly misappropriated more than $5.8 million for his personal expenses, including the purchase, renovation, and furnishing of his home. Boateng also allegedly used approximately $6.6 million to make Ponzi-like payments to earlier investors. The complaint further alleges that, to the limited extent Boateng did invest the money, he failed to do so in low-risk investments with fixed returns. Instead, according to the complaint, Boateng used investor money to engage in high-risk, speculative day trading, leading to more than $750,000 in trading losses. “We allege that the defendants’ investors included retirees, taxi drivers, home health care providers, students, an ailing widow with young children, and at least two churches and one prayer group,” said Thomas P. body: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX), the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA), the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA) and Nasdaq Dubai are pleased to announce today (Thursday) the establishment of a Strategic Working Group to deepen cooperation and strengthen financial market connectivity between Hong Kong and the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). Building on ongoing regulatory and market dialogue, the Strategic Working Group brings together exchanges and regulators from Hong Kong and the DIFC through a structured platform to align strategic priorities and pursue practical initiatives that support the continued growth and attractiveness of both markets. Its areas of focus will include sustainable finance, Islamic finance, innovation, capital markets development and market connectivity. The announcement was made at the HKMA-DFSA Joint Climate Finance Conference held in Hong Kong today, which attracted over 350 in-person and online participants from the two regions. This year marks the third edition of the flagship conference jointly presented by the HKMA and the DFSA, and the second year in which HKEX and Nasdaq Dubai have participated as strategic partners. HKEX Chief Executive Officer, Bonnie Y Chan, said: “Global capital flows are increasingly being shaped by the growing economic ties between Asia and the Middle East. As leading international financial centres at the heart of their respective regions, Hong Kong and Dubai have complementary strengths that can help facilitate the two-way flow of capital, ideas and opportunities. HKEX’s growing commodities presence in Dubai, together with our engagement with exchanges across the UAE, reflects our long-term commitment to this dynamic corridor. The Strategic Working Group is an important next step in translating that commitment into action by deepening collaboration, advancing market connectivity, and supporting innovation and sustainable growth.” HKMA Chief Executive, Eddie Yue, said: “The Strategic Working Group marks another key step in deepening our institutional ties and market connectivity.

body: Washington D.C., Sept. 3, 2026 — The Securities and Exchange Commission today issued a proposal to rescind its “pay-to-play” rule that prohibits investment advisers from providing compensated investment advisory services to a government client for two years after making a political contribution to certain elected officials or candidates, and related recordkeeping requirements. All other requirements of the Advisers Act and its associated rules, including prohibitions on fraud, fiduciary duty requirements, the compliance rule, and the code of ethics rule, would continue to apply. The Commission has determined that the political contribution rule, since its adoption in 2010, has led to significant unintended consequences, such as prohibitions by some advisers on political contributions at the state and local level. Advisers have indicated that the rule is operationally challenging to implement, and creates a de facto strict liability standard, which can lead to situations where small donations or “foot faults” potentially trigger substantial prohibitions and fines. “After more than 15 years of experience administering the ‘pay-to-play’ rule, it is clear that it is overly prescriptive and has produced a host of unintended consequences. Beyond operational implementation challenges, it has imposed serious penalties for small, often impulsive donations to candidates in both parties, and routinely punishes and handicaps advisory firms for an employee making a donation even before joining the business. Furthermore, advisers’ implementation of the rule has effectively resulted in the suppression of political speech,” said SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins in a statement. “Ultimately, matters involving political contributions are more properly governed by local ordinances, state laws, and federal election regulations—not by the SEC.” Specifically, the proposal would rescind Advisers Act Rule 206(4)-5 and amend the Advisers Act recordkeeping rule to eliminate the corresponding provisions related to the political contribution rule. The public comment period will remain open for 60 days after the proposing release is published in the Federal Register.
bodyZh: 华盛顿特区，2026 年 9 月 3 日 — 美国证券交易委员会今天发布一项提案，废除其“付费”规则，该规则禁止投资顾问在向某些民选官员或候选人提供政治捐款后两年内向政府客户提供有偿投资咨询服务，以及相关的记录保存要求。 《顾问法》及其相关规则的所有其他要求，包括禁止欺诈、信托责任要求、合规规则和道德准则规则，将继续适用。委员会确定，政治捐款规则自 2010 年通过以来已导致严重的意外后果，例如一些顾问禁止州和地方一级的政治捐款。顾问表示，该规则在操作上实施起来具有挑战性，并创建了事实上的严格责任标准，这可能导致小额捐款或“脚错”可能引发大量禁令和罚款的情况。 “经过超过 15 年的‘付费游戏’规则管理经验，很明显它过于规范，并产生了一系列意想不到的后果。除了运营实施方面的挑战之外，它还对向两党候选人进行的小额、往往是冲动的捐款施加了严厉的处罚，并且经常对咨询公司的员工在加入企业之前进行捐款进行惩罚和阻碍。此外，顾问执行该规则实际上导致了对政治言论的压制，”SEC 主席表示。保罗·S·阿特金斯在一份声明中。 “最终，涉及政治献金的事宜更应该由地方法令、州法律和联邦选举法规管辖，而不是由 SEC 管辖。”具体来说，该提案将废除《顾问法》第 206(4)-5 条，并修订《顾问法》记录保存规则，以消除与政治献金规则相关的相应规定。公众意见征询期将在提议发布于《联邦公报》后 60 天内开放。

body: Washington D.C., Sept. 1, 2026 — The Securities and Exchange Commission today announced the agenda and panelists for its Sept. 17, 2026, roundtable on preparations for 24-hour trading. The roundtable will be held at the SEC’s headquarters at 100 F Street, N.E., Washington, D.C., from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. ET. The event will be open to the public and webcast live on the SEC’s website. Doors will open at 9 a.m. ET. For in-person attendance, please visit the registration page. Visitors will be subject to security checks. For online attendance, registration is not necessary; a link to watch the event will be available on Sept. 17 at www.sec.gov, and a recording will be available at a later date on the SEC’s website. More information, including how to submit comments, is available on the SEC’s Roundtable on Preparations for 24-Hour Trading event page. Panel One – Preparedness for a 24-Hour MarketPanel One will examine preparations for the launch of 24 hour trading, focusing on exchange and broker dealer readiness, overnight surveillance, closing price processes, clearance and settlement changes, and investor protection practices. The panel will also highlight what has been completed, what remains, and expected liquidity conditions as markets move toward near continuous trading.Moderators: Jon Kroeper – SEC Division of Trading and MarketsKatie Kolchin, CFA – Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association Matt Billings – Robinhood Josh Burch – NYSE Hubert De Jesus – BlackRockJD Del Raso – Virtu FinancialHeidi Fischer – Cboe Ron Hooey – BNY PershingTodd Lopez – UBSRobert McNamee – FINRAJason Wallach – Bruce Markets Panel Two – Resiliency in a 24-Hour MarketPanel Two will explore operational resiliency in a 24‑hour market, including systems readiness, Regulation SCI considerations, failover and capacity planning, market‑data continuity, shortened maintenance windows, cybersecurity, and staffing models for overnight operations.

body: Washington D.C., Sept. 1, 2026 — The Securities and Exchange Commission today charged Mark D. Hanf, the former CEO of Novato, California-based Pacific Private Money Group LLC (PPMG), and Hoai-Nam Chu Phan, the former COO of a PPMG subsidiary, with orchestrating an offering fraud that raised more than $80 million from approximately 190 mostly retail investors, many of whom were retired senior citizens. According to the SEC’s complaint, from approximately December 2021 to November 2025, Hanf and Phan, also known as Nam Phan, misrepresented to investors in two of PPMG’s private funds that investor capital would be used to originate or purchase loans secured by real estate, and that investors could expect to receive preferred or fixed rates of return from the funds’ real estate lending activities. However, as alleged, Hanf and Phan regularly used new investor capital to make Ponzi-like payments to prior investors during this timeframe, and the returns that Hanf and Phan touted were sourced largely from new investor money rather than from any fund earnings connected with their real estate lending business. The SEC further alleges that Hanf misappropriated more than $7 million of investor funds for his own personal benefit. “This alleged scheme began to unravel in the fall of 2025 as numerous investors demanded to withdraw their money and the defendants did not have sufficient funds to satisfy those requests,” said Jason Lee, Associate Director of the SEC’s San Francisco Regional Office. “Despite total outstanding investments in the two private funds of almost $121 million, by February 2026 the total recoverable assets of those funds were estimated to be less than $17 million. That amounts to devastating losses for so many investors.” The SEC’s complaint, filed in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California, charges Hanf with violating Section 17(a) of the Securities Act of 1933 and Section 10(b) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and Rule 10b-5 thereunder, and charges Phan with violating Sections 17(a)(1) and (3) of the Securities Act and Section 10(b) of the Exchange Act and Rule 10b-5 thereunder.

Hanf 和 PPMG 子公司前首席运营官 Hoai-Nam Chu Phan 策划了一项发行欺诈行为，从约 190 名主要散户投资者（其中许多是退休老年人）筹集了超过 8000 万美元。根据 SEC 的诉状，大约从 2021 年 12 月到 2025 年 11 月，Hanf 和 Phan（也称为 Nam Phan）向 PPMG 两只私募基金的投资者歪曲，称投资者的资金将用于发起或购买以房地产担保的贷款，并且投资者可以期望从基金的房地产贷款活动中获得优先或固定回报率。然而，正如所指控的那样，Hanf 和 Phan 在此期间经常使用新的投资者资金向先前的投资者进行类似庞氏骗局的付款，而 Hanf 和 Phan 吹捧的回报主要来自新投资者的资金，而不是来自与其房地产贷款业务相关的任何基金收益。 SEC 进一步指控汉夫为了个人利益挪用了超过 700 万美元的投资者资金。美国证券交易委员会旧金山地区办事处副主任杰森·李 (Jason Lee) 表示：“这一所谓的计划于 2025 年秋季开始败露，因为众多投资者要求撤回资金，而被告没有足够的资金来满足这些要求。” “尽管这两只私募基金的未偿投资总额接近 1.21 亿美元，但到 2026 年 2 月，这些基金的可收回资产总额估计不到 1700 万美元。这对许多投资者来说相当于毁灭性的损失。” SEC 向美国加利福尼亚州北区地方法院提起诉讼，指控 Hanf 违反 1933 年《证券法》第 17(a) 条和 1934 年《证券交易法》第 10(b) 条及其下的第 10b-5 条，并指控 Phan 违反《证券法》第 17(a)(1) 和 (3) 条以及《交易法》第 10(b) 条和其下的规则 10b-5。

body: Washington D.C., Sept. 1, 2026 — The Securities and Exchange Commission today proposed to update the rules and forms that apply to registered transfer agents. Transfer agents are a key component of the national clearance and settlement system. Transfer agents now perform a more diverse array of functions and services that may not be adequately addressed by the Commission’s transfer agent rules, which have not been substantively updated since the first rules were adopted in the late 1970s and early 1980s. The rule proposal would modernize the federal transfer agent rules, while continuing to facilitate the safe and efficient functioning of the U.S. securities markets and the national clearance and settlement system. “This proposal would streamline and modernize the Commission’s rules to reflect transfer agents’ current processes and operations, including the use of electronic communications and blockchain technology in connection with securities offerings and the transfer of shares,” said SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins. “As technology changes and the competitive marketplace evolves, good government requires revisiting legacy rules and regulations,” said Jamie Selway, Director of the SEC’s Division of Trading and Markets. “This proposal is another important step in Chairman Atkins' efforts to advance our regulatory framework for the modern era." The proposed rule updates reflect the technological environment in which transfer agents operate, including the widespread use of electronic recordkeeping and communications, and the services they provide to issuers, investors, and other market intermediaries. The proposal would amend existing rules and forms, would rescind a rule, and would introduce new rules that apply to registered transfer agents and their activities. The proposing release is published on SEC.gov and will be published in the Federal Register. The public comment period will remain open for 60 days after the date of publication in the Federal Register. Last Reviewed or Updated: Sept.

Atkins) 表示：“这项提案将简化和现代化委员会的规则，以反映转让代理当前的流程和运营，包括在证券发行和股票转让方面使用电子通信和区块链技术。” “随着技术的变化和竞争市场的发展，良好的政府需要重新审视遗留的规则和法规，”美国证券交易委员会交易和市场部主任 Jamie Selway 表示。 “这项提议是阿特金斯主席努力推进现代监管框架的又一个重要步骤。”拟议的规则更新反映了转让代理运作的技术环境，包括电子记录保存和通信的广泛使用，以及他们向发行人、投资者和其他市场中介机构提供的服务。该提案将修改现有规则和表格，废除一项规则，并引入适用于注册转让代理人及其活动的新规则。该提案发布在 SEC.gov 上，并将在《联邦公报》上发布。公众意见征询期将在《联邦公报》发布之日起 60 天内开放。最后审查或更新：九月

body: Washington D.C., Aug. 31, 2026 — The Securities and Exchange Commission and the Food and Drug Administration today announced that they have entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) designed to assist the agencies in carrying out their respective missions of ensuring the integrity of the financial markets and protecting public health. The MOU establishes a framework for the agencies to enhance cooperation in their regulatory and enforcement responsibilities in order to improve market oversight and compliance. Among other things, the MOU includes information-sharing protocols to facilitate the exchange of information between the SEC and FDA that is relevant to both agencies’ important missions. “FDA-related disclosures by public companies have a significant impact on our markets,” said SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins. “The FDA is a valuable partner in our efforts to administer and enforce applicable disclosure requirements under the federal securities laws, and I look forward to further strengthening our partnership through the MOU.” “We are proud to partner with the SEC to enhance transparency across the life sciences sector,” said Acting FDA Commissioner Kyle Diamantas J.D. “Streamlining our information-sharing helps protect both the patients who rely on FDA-regulated products and the public trust that drives healthcare innovation.” The MOU will remain in effect for a period of three years, and it may be extended or modified by the mutual written consent of the agencies. Last Reviewed or Updated: Aug.

Atkins 表示。 “FDA 是我们努力管理和执行联邦证券法适用的披露要求的宝贵合作伙伴，我期待通过谅解备忘录进一步加强我们的合作伙伴关系。” FDA 代理专员 Kyle Diamantas J.D 表示：“我们很荣幸与 SEC 合作，提高整个生命科学领域的透明度。简化我们的信息共享有助于保护依赖 FDA 监管产品的患者和推动医疗创新的公众信任。”该谅解备忘录的有效期为三年，经双方书面同意后可以延长或修改。上次审查或更新：八月

Atkins) 表示：“长期以来，像这样的缺口——几个欧盟成员国的债务得到了偿付，但欧盟本身的债务却没有得到偿付——已经造成了这种不一致，从而滋生了市场的混乱，而不是信心。” “这项提议是实践中的协调，建立在我们与美国商品期货交易委员会 (CFTC) 共同努力的基础上，旨在保护投资者，同时缩小监管差距。”拟议的修正案将把欧盟债务期货合约置于 CFTC 的专属管辖范围内，这与目前根据规则 3a12-8 列出的几个欧盟成员国债务期货已经受到的监管待遇一致。基础债务债券本身的发行仍将受到联邦证券法的约束。委员会提议的修正案将： 提议的版本发布在 SEC.gov 上，并将发布在《联邦公报》上。意见征询期将在《联邦公报》发布之日起 60 天内开放。上次审查或更新：八月

body: Washington D.C., Aug. 27, 2026 — The Securities and Exchange Commission today charged 38 entities alleging that they made material misrepresentations in Forms ADV filed with the Commission between 2025 and 2026 to falsely portray themselves as legitimate advisory firms to U.S. investors. The complaints also allege that the defendants, a number of whom used IP addresses that were tracked to foreign jurisdictions to connect to the Commission’s filing system, failed to respond to requests by Commission counsel to provide records to substantiate information on their Forms ADV. “Our complaints allege large-scale abuse of SEC adviser filings by persons, several of whom are likely located overseas, exploiting interest in emerging technologies,” said Laura D’Allaird, Chief of the SEC Enforcement Division's Cyber and Emerging Technologies Unit. “When we find bad actors using fraudulent SEC filings to feign legitimacy with retail investors, we will act decisively to disrupt these operations.” According to the complaints, the defendants made material misrepresentations and statements that could not be substantiated in Forms ADV filings, including listing places of business at addresses in Colorado where the defendants had no presence and providing phone numbers that are disconnected or belong to unrelated businesses. The SEC complaints also allege that the defendants disclosed an ownership structure and numerical data that was identical or nearly identical to a multitude of other purported exempt reporting advisers (ERA) and claimed that the financial statements of the private funds they purportedly advised had been audited by one of two independent public accounting firms, neither of which can be found in any public registry of federal or state accountancy firms. The SEC also alleges that certain defendants have been marketed on websites, some of which displayed a fake certificate indicating that the defendant was registered with the SEC, even though it was not. The complaints, filed in the United States District Court for the District of Colorado, charge the defendants with violating Sections 204(a) and 207 of the Investment Advisers Act of 1940.
bodyZh: 华盛顿特区，2026 年 8 月 27 日——美国证券交易委员会今天对 ​​38 家实体提出指控，指控它们在 2025 年至 2026 年间向委员会提交的 ADV 表格中做出重大虚假陈述，错误地将自己描绘成向美国投资者提供的合法咨询公司。投诉还称，被告中的一些人使用被追踪到外国司法管辖区的 IP 地址连接到委员会的备案系统，但未能回应委员会律师提供记录以证实其 ADV 表格上信息的要求。美国证券交易委员会执法部门网络和新兴技术部门负责人劳拉·达莱尔德 (Laura D’Allaird) 表示：“我们的投诉称，一些人（其中一些人可能位于海外）大规模滥用美国证券交易委员会顾问的备案文件，利用对新兴技术的兴趣。” “当我们发现不良行为者利用欺诈性的 SEC 文件向散户投资者伪装合法性时，我们将果断采取行动，扰乱这些操作。”根据投诉，被告做出了无法在 ADV 表格文件中得到证实的重大失实陈述和陈述，包括列出了被告在科罗拉多州没有业务的地址的营业地点，以及提供了已断开或属于不相关企业的电话号码。美国证券交易委员会的投诉还称，被告披露的所有权结构和数字数据与许多其他所谓的豁免报告顾问（ERA）相同或几乎相同，并声称他们据称提供咨询服务的私人基金的财务报表已经过两家独立公共会计师事务所之一的审计，而这两家会计师事务所在任何联邦或州会计师事务所的公共注册处都找不到。美国证券交易委员会还声称，某些被告已在网站上进行营销，其中一些网站显示了虚假证书，表明被告已在美国证券交易委员会注册，尽管事实并非如此。这些诉状向美国科罗拉多州地方法院提起，指控被告违反 1940 年《投资顾问法》第 204(a) 条和第 207 条。

body: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX) is pleased to announce today (Monday) the appointment of Mr Carl Wong as Managing Director, Head of External Communications. Mr Wong will join HKEX on 21 September 2026 and in this new role, he will be responsible for overseeing HKEX’s external communications functions, including media relations, social media, content development and speechwriting, leading a dedicated team of communications and content specialists. He will report to HKEX Group Chief Communications Officer, Jeffrey Ng. Mr Wong joins HKEX from Manulife, where he spent more than a decade in senior communications positions, most recently in a dual role as Head of External Communications for Manulife Asia and Head of Communications, Asia, for Manulife Investment Management. HKEX Group Chief Communications Officer, Jeffrey Ng, said: “I am delighted to welcome Carl to the HKEX family. He brings over 25 years of experience across the financial and corporate communications spectrum, including leadership counsel, issues management, digital storytelling, and talent development. He will be a vital addition as we advance the Group’s strategy to build a multi-asset ecosystem that supports the long-term development of Hong Kong’s markets.” Prior to Manulife, Mr Wong worked at Sun Hung Kai Properties and held senior roles at international public relations firms including Fleishman-Hillard and Ketchum. He holds a Bachelor of Science from Ohio University in the US. Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX) is a publicly-traded company (HKEX Stock Code: 388) and one of the world’s leading global exchange groups, offering a range of equity, derivative, commodity, fixed income and other financial markets, products and services, including the London Metal Exchange. body: Washington D.C., Aug. 18, 2026 — The Securities and Exchange Commission today charged Daniel Chu, Jerome Kollar, and Ameryn Seibold, the former CEO, CFO, and Senior Director of Finance, respectively, at Texas-based Tricolor Holdings, LLC, for their roles in an alleged multi-year scheme to defraud investors by double pledging hundreds of millions of dollars of subprime auto loans to multiple asset-backed securities (ABS) offerings and lenders.
